## Docs

A change under `cli/src`, the launcher (`npm/agent-qa/lib`, `npm/agent-qa/bin`), or the workbench (`npm/agent-qa/web/src`) needs a reader-facing doc update. `docs/gap-map.md`, `docs/qa-playground.md`, `docs/specs/`, and `CHANGELOG.md` do not count. The `docs check` workflow enforces this.

- [ ] Updated the page or skill a reader would open for this change
- [ ] No reader-facing change. Add a line on its own: `Docs-exempt: <why>`
